verdict.rationale: Agora is an API/SDK platform, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair axis. The evidence only says RESTful APIs exist (agora-docs-24). Nothing documents API versions, version pinning, or a deprecation or sunset policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
